The '''Way of Schesa''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and was one of the few routes to lead into [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]], a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that was fortified by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] to serve as a last stand in case of an enemy invasion. One of its endpoints lay at the northern end of the [[Path of the Houses]]&mdash;a route connecting the home [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]&mdash;within the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The route then headed toward the Redoubt, its eastern terminus. The other terminal point of the route&mdash;the planet [[Schesa/Legends|Schesa]]&mdash;was home to a [[Unidentified Chiss Ruling Family|former Ruling Family]], which eventually found itself on the losing side of a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil war]] before the [[Swarm War]], while another world along the route, [[Pesfavri/Legends|Pesfavri]], was a CEDF base.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Way of Schesa debuted in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The route is pictured on a map that accompanies the description of the Chiss Ascendancy and shows its core territory and its immediate vicinity. The route was also mentioned&mdash;albeit indirectly&mdash;in the description of Pesfavri on the same page.<ref name="Atlas" />
